formulas.ascii: Over the kNN table: k-distance d_k(j) = largest neighbour distance of row j; reach(i, j) = max(d_k(j), d(i, j)); local reachability density lrd(i) = 1 / (mean over neighbours j of reach(i, j) + densityFloor); LOF(i) = mean over neighbours j of lrd(j) / lrd(i). A row with no neighbours gets density 0 and LOF 1. Scores …
